text_block_list.text:
At Inari One's request, I was supposed to help
prepare for a festival in her local shopping district, but...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: When it's the festival for the shopping district that supports me so much, how could I show up in anything else?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'll boost both my spirit and motivation
with this—
Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
We're finally at the halfway mark for preparations,
but at this rate, I wonder if we'll make it in time for the day...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Come on, what's with the long faces?!
Keep that up, and you'll dampen the whole festival's mood!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Inari-chan!!
Haha... You're right! It's a festival!
No time to stand around moping!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text: "Still, that's one fine festive outfit! It's brightened up my spirit completely!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit!
Let's make this the greatest festival in all of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
Inari-chan, Inari-chan!
We're having trouble setting up the roof
on this stall...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If you can't do it alone, do it together!
Everyone! Lend me a hand!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ready? We're gonna lift the roof all at once on "heave-ho", got it? One, two——!!
And in that manner, Inari One went around to various places, making a name for herself—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Festivals really are fun,
starting right from the prep work!
choice_data_list: You really put on quite a show out there.
You really did an amazing job today.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Damn straight! I've been helping out
at festivals ever since I was a kid!
'Course I'd be used to it—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local C
text_block_list.text: T-This is terrible~~! A fight broke out between the carpenters over there!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oho!
Looks like Lady Inari's needed once again.
choice_data_list: Wait! Isn't that a bit dangerous...?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't you worry!
I'm used to breaking up fights!
Besides—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If I back down from a fight,
it'd bring shame to this racing silk!!
Inari One scarfs down the grilled carrot in one go and dashes off toward the scene—

While respecting her wishes,
I hurried after her so I could react immediately
if anything were to happen...

text_block_list.name: Brawling Carpenters
text_block_list.text:
—You stole the last fried chicken bento!
—It's your fault for being slow! Go eat a nori bento!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Is this the place? The scene of the fire they're all talkin' about.
Well, in that case...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, take a look!
Festival brawls are the pride of Edo!
Put on a flashy show for us!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"So with that said, I'm counting on you two!
Make sure the customers leave happy~!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local D
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's how it is, huh!
Well then, we gotta hype things up too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "Now then, you two? Care to explain what this fight is about? Seeing such an uproar... I'd wager this is quite the magnificent clash of stubborn pride!"

text_block_list.name: Carpenter A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no, I mean, it's not like I'm being stubborn,
or that it was even that big of a fight...

text_block_list.name: Carpenter B
text_block_list.text:
W-What are you gonna do, dumbass,
gathering a whole crowd of people
over something so stupid?!

text_block_list.name: Carpenter A
text_block_list.text:
Aargh... Well, a nori bento isn't so bad once in a while!
Forget it! Let's stop fighting!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And with that, case closed! ...Or so they say!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This is a piece of cake!
Besides, I'm wearing this outfit right now, ain't I?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"This outfit, see,
is basically like the firefighting gear worn by firemen."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: When people see me rushing to the scene, everyone knows they can count on me, and everyone gets hyped for the action! That's what my racing suit is all about.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "So whenever I'm wearin' this outfit, I wanna run with everything I've got and entertain everyone with all my might!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whether it's a race or anywhere else... right.
choice_data_list: Then maybe I'll join in and have fun too!
In that case, maybe I'll join in on the fun too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whether it's a race or anywhere else... right.
choice_data_list: Then maybe I'll join in and have fun too!
In that case, maybe I'll join in on the fun too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course!
Who do ya think I am?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: The one whose name will roar across the land someday—that's me, the great Inari!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If I can't even do this much,
it'd tarnish my name, let alone my racing attire!

Seeing Inari One so fired up,
I joined the people of the shopping district
in applauding her.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me, I tell ya!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Stick with me,
and you'll have a blast anywhere!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well then, to start off,
let's enjoy continuing our preparations! Right, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Everyone from the Shopping District
text_block_list.text: Ooh yeah!!
After that, everyone united as one, wrapping up the festival preparations in high spirits.
